The '''Nexer system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Prackla sector/Legends|Prackla sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].

The system was the base of operations [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Gaor Tembon]] during the first years of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].
